# crosswork_credential_profiles (Resource)

This resource can manage a credential profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_credential_profiles" "example" {
  profile = "cwtest-profile"
  credentials = [
    {
      type                             = "ROBOT_USERPASS_SSH"
      user_name                        = "cwtest-user"
      password_wo                      = "Cwtest-Password-1"
      password_wo_version              = 1
      enable_password                  = "ROBOT_USERPASSEN_ENABLE"
      enable_password_value_wo         = "Cwtest-Enable-1"
      enable_password_value_wo_version = 1
    }
  ]
  snmpv2_read_community_wo          = "cwtest-read"
  snmpv2_read_community_wo_version  = 1
  snmpv2_write_community_wo         = "cwtest-write"
  snmpv2_write_community_wo_version = 1
  snmpv3_user_name                  = "cwtest-snmp"
  snmpv3_security_level             = "SL_AUTH_PRIV"
  snmpv3_auth_type                  = "AT_HMAC_SHA"
  snmpv3_auth_password_wo           = "Cwtest-Auth-1"
  snmpv3_auth_password_wo_version   = 1
  snmpv3_priv_type                  = "PT_CFB_AES_128"
  snmpv3_priv_password_wo           = "Cwtest-Priv-1"
  snmpv3_priv_password_wo_version   = 1
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `profile` (String) Credential profile name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `credentials` (Attributes List) List of credentials, one per access type (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `snmpv2_read_community` (String, Sensitive) SNMPv2 read community
  - Only one of `snmpv2_read_community` and `snmpv2_read_community_wo` can be set.
  - This attribute stores the secret in Terraform state. Prefer `snmpv2_read_community_wo` together with `snmpv2_read_community_wo_version`, which keeps it out of state.
- `snmpv2_read_community_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SNMPv2 read community
  - Only one of `snmpv2_read_community` and `snmpv2_read_community_wo` can be set.
- `snmpv2_read_community_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `snmpv2_read_community_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `snmpv2_write_community` (String, Sensitive) SNMPv2 write community
  - Only one of `snmpv2_write_community` and `snmpv2_write_community_wo` can be set.
  - This attribute stores the secret in Terraform state. Prefer `snmpv2_write_community_wo` together with `snmpv2_write_community_wo_version`, which keeps it out of state.

  - Only one of `snmpv2_write_community` and `snmpv2_write_community_wo` can be set.
- `snmpv2_write_community_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `snmpv2_write_community_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `snmpv3_auth_password` (String, Sensitive) SNMPv3 authentication password
  - Only one of `snmpv3_auth_password` and `snmpv3_auth_password_wo` can be set.
  - This attribute stores the secret in Terraform state. Prefer `snmpv3_auth_password_wo` together with `snmpv3_auth_password_wo_version`, which keeps it out of state.
- `snmpv3_auth_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SNMPv3 authentication password
  - Only one of `snmpv3_auth_password` and `snmpv3_auth_password_wo` can be set.

  - Choices: `AT_HMAC_MD5`, `AT_HMAC_SHA`, `AT_HMAC_SHA2_512`, `AT_HMAC_SHA2_384`, `AT_HMAC_SHA2_256`, `AT_HMAC_SHA2_224`
- `snmpv3_priv_password` (String, Sensitive) SNMPv3 privacy password
  - Only one of `snmpv3_priv_password` and `snmpv3_priv_password_wo` can be set.

  - Choices: `SL_NO_AUTH_NO_PRIV`, `SL_AUTH_NO_PRIV`, `SL_AUTH_PRIV`

### Nested Schema for `credentials`

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password
  - Only one of `password` and `password_wo` can be set.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_credential_profiles.example "<profile>"
```
